_what: Frozen provenance of the shared substrate the vp_frontal simulation runs on. These digests are the frozen mind v1.57 R19 engine and its emergence tree (READ-ONLY). The frontal sim NEVER mutates the engine; engine_tripwire.py asserts these on every gate run, and frontal_common.engine_anchor_bitforbit() reproduces the M9 anchor EXACTLY (bit-for-bit) via the engine integrator.
decoupling: vp_frontal is an INDEPENDENT simulation, NOT the 29th atlas citizen. It shares the engine + 3 layers READ-ONLY (hash-pinned), has its OWN lightweight gate (frontal_gate.py), and NEVER calls the mind atlas runner run_all_atlas.py.
